logger.doc:name: Log Rejected Record
logger.message: #['REJECTED SKU=' ++ (payload.sku default 'UNKNOWN') ++ ' RunId=' ++ (vars.runId default '') ++ ' Errors=' ++ write(vars.validationResult.errors, 'application/json')]

ee:transform.doc:name: Compute SHA-256 Hash â€” calls compute-hash.dwl

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/java var full = (payload.productName default "") ++ "|" ++ (payload.categoryCode default "") ++ "|" ++ (payload.brand default "") ++ "|" ++ ((((payload.price as Number) default 0) as String {format: "0.00"}) default "0.00") ++ "|" ++ (payload.currency default "") ++ "|" ++ (payload.taxClass default "") ++ "|" ++ (payload.stockStatus default "") ++ "|" ++ (payload.productStatus default "") ++ "|" ++ (payload.shortDescription default "") ++ "|" ++ (payload.imagePath default "") --- full[0 to 63]

until-successful.doc:name: Retry DB Lookup on Transient Error

db:select.doc:name: Query Existing Product
db:select.db:sql: SELECT sku, product_name, category_code, brand, price, currency, tax_class, stock_status, product_status, short_description, image_path, content_hash FROM products WHERE sku = :sku

ee:transform.doc:name: Evaluate Price Swing â€” calls price-guard-check.dwl

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/java var oldPrice = (vars.storedProduct.price as Number) default 0 var newPrice = (payload.price as Number) default 0 var maxIncrease = (p("priceGuard.maxIncreasePercent") default "50") as Number var maxDecrease = (p("priceGuard.maxDecreasePercent") default "40") as Number var increasePct = if (oldPrice > 0 and newPrice > oldPrice) ((newPrice - oldPrice) / oldPrice) * 100 else 0 var decreasePct = if (oldPrice > 0 and newPrice < oldPrice) ((oldPrice - newPrice) / oldPrice) * 100 else 0 var isSuspicious = (oldPrice > 0) and (increasePct > maxIncrease or decreasePct > maxDecrease) --- { isSuspicious: isSuspicious, reason: if (increasePct > maxIncrease) "Price increase of " ++ (increasePct as String {format: "0.0"}) ++ "% exceeds max " ++ (maxIncrease as String) ++ "%" else if (decreasePct > maxDecrease) "Price decrease of " ++ (decreasePct as String {format: "0.0"}) ++ "% exceeds max " ++ (maxDecrease as String) ++ "%" else "", increasePct: increasePct, decreasePct: decreasePct, action: if (isSuspicious) (p("priceGuard.action") default "HOLD_FOR_REVIEW") else "APPLY" }

logger.doc:name: Log Batch Complete
logger.message: #['BATCH_COMPLETE RunId=' ++ (vars.runId default '') ++ ' Total=' ++ payload.totalRecords ++ ' Failed=' ++ payload.failedRecords ++ ' Loaded=' ++ payload.loadedRecords]

db:update.doc:name: Update Parsed and Rejected Counts
db:update.db:sql: UPDATE catalog_import_runs SET parsed_count = :parsedCount, rejected_count = :rejectedCount WHERE run_id = :runId

logger.doc:name: Could not write batch counts
logger.message: #['Could not update parsed/rejected counts for RunId=' ++ (vars.runId default '')]
